uncertaintyMeaning: Published statistical/Monte Carlo fit error; excludes the additional systematic term below.
systematicMeaning: Original publication reports approximately 10% additional systematic uncertainty in diameter. This is a population-level floor, not a shape-specific accuracy guarantee.
quantity: NEATM effective spherical diameter at the observing geometry
selectionReason: Selected fully cryogenic W3/W4 observations with fitted beaming over the shorter-wavelength Masiero2012 fit; those short-wave fits carry larger systematic errors and stronger dependence on assumed optical H.
formula: scaleKmPerSourceUnit = diameterKm / cbrt(6 * signedSourceVolume / pi); meterScale =1000*scaleKmPerSourceUnit. Original shape coordinates are preserved.
limitations: The thermal effective spherical diameter is used as an approximate volume-equivalent display scale; no joint shape/thermal inversion or independently measured volume is implied.
Published thermal fits disagree: 17.919 km (Mas12), 26.393 km (Mas14). Selected the W3/W4 fit; this discrepancy is retained as a scale limitation.
Quoted ±0.439 km is the catalog fit error; approximately 10% additional systematic diameter uncertainty applies.
visibleDescription: Approximate scale from a thermal diameter of 26.393 ± 0.439 km. Quoted fit error excludes about 10% survey systematic uncertainty and shape/aspect effects. Another thermal fit gives 17.9 km.
